newsitem.title: USA: Bausch & Lomb sees Q4 EPS less than $0.40.
newsitem.headline: Bausch & Lomb sees Q4 EPS less than $0.40.

text.p: Bausch & Lomb Inc said Thursday that it expects its fourth quarter earnings excluding special charges would be less than half the $0.40 per share reported in the comparable 1995 period.
The eye care company attributed the news to continued softness in its sunglass business, including order cancellations from its largest customer, Sunglass Hut International Inc.

The company said Sunglass Hut sales were lower than it expected and has canceled all fourth quarter deliveries of all Bausch & Lomb sunglass lines. Bausch & Lomb said it also foresees lower than expected revenues from its pharmaceutical business in Germany.

The company said these developments should not affect its planned 1997 business performance. It said it is developing plans to aggressively cut fixed costs and improve operating margins to ensure improved earnings in 1997 and beyond.
